1. \(x - 2 \leq 5.6\)
2. \(-(x - 2) \leq 5.6\)

1. \(x - 2 \leq 5.6\) simplifies to \(x \leq 7.6\).
2. \(-(x - 2) \leq 5.6\) simplifies to \(-x + 2 \leq 5.6\), which further simplifies to \(-x \leq 3.6\) or \(x \geq -3.6\).
